provenance.title: Data for "Suppressing quantum errors by scaling a surface code logical qubit"
provenance.data_kind: experimental measurements from Google's Sycamore processor (not simulated)
provenance.scope: first N real shots of surface-code experiments with rounds <= 5; N=5000 (d=3), N=2000 (d=5)
provenance.paired_all: exact McNemar + paired bootstrap of the noise-aware Ising decoder vs every method

ablation_noise_aware_vs_uniform.comparison: noise-aware minus uniform failure rate on identical shots

gap_analysis.definition: Complementary gap: E(best solution whose observable prediction is flipped) - E(best solution), in nats. exp(-gap) compares two single explanations, not class probabilities.
